claim: With AWS Backup you can back up and restore VSS-enabled Windows applications running on Amazon EC2 instances; if the application has a VSS writer registered with Windows VSS, AWS Backup creates a snapshot that is consistent for that application. AWS Backup only supports application-consistent backups of resources running on Amazon EC2, and not all instance types or applications are supported for Windows VSS backups.

evidence.quote: With AWS Backup, you can back up and restore VSS (Volume Shadow Copy Service)-enabled Windows applications running on Amazon EC2 instances. If the application has VSS writer registered with Windows VSS, then AWS Backup creates a snapshot that will be consistent for that application.

AWS Backup only supports application-consistent backups of resources running on Amazon EC2, specifically backup scenarios where application data can be restored by replacing an existing instance with a new instance created from the backup. Not all instance types or applications are supported for Windows VSS backups.
